CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cyberpunk Theme for the Unraid 7.x webGUI, by liekos47. A dark, neon theme layered over the stock webGUI with nine palettes, picked from a settings page with a live preview. No Unraid file is modified, and Reset to default brings back the stock look at any time.
Fan-made: the palettes take colour values only from Cyberpunk 2077, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners and Mass Effect, with no game or show assets. Not affiliated with CD PROJEKT RED, Studio Trigger, BioWare, Electronic Arts or Lime Technology.
Support is in the Unraid forum thread. Bug reports and new palettes are welcome on GitHub.
